name: Barachois Pond Provincial Park

fees.note: $20.15 a night for an unserviced site; no serviced sites here. The same every night of the week, and no out-of-province rate. Each vehicle also needs the $7 nightly vehicle pass (or a $50 seasonal pass to all provincial parks), and each booking carries a $7.00 reservation fee (incl. tax). Residents of the province aged 65+ get 35% off. ParksNL's fee page and booking site (2027 nights), read 2026-10-12.
